diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts because the model defaulted to setting the 'driver_training_vehicle_count' to 6, which matches the value specified in PF2. This default value allows the check to pass without requiring any hidden information from A3.

C3.why: The inspection status changes the driver block to Friday after 0800, sets six vehicles for that block while only four are currently released, and requires a hold on the two unreleased trucks.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C3 to require the 'driver_training_vehicle_count' to be based on the number of released vehicles plus any additional vehicles requested, as specified in PF2. Specifically, update the check to ensure that the 'driver_training_vehicle_count' cannot exceed the sum of 'released_vehicle_count' and any additional vehicles requested.
